title: Geometric-stalk support agrees with ordinary support on etale scheme charts
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $M$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module on its small etale ringed site [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Write $\operatorname{Supp}_X(M)$ for the set of $x\in|X|$ at which a geometric stalk $M_{\bar x}$ is nonzero, with $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ over $x$ and $\Omega$ algebraically closed; the vanishing condition is independent of this choice. Let $e:U\to X$ be any etale map from a scheme. Under the equivalence [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence], regard the restriction $e^*M$ as a quasi-coherent Zariski module $M_U$ on $U$. Define $\operatorname{Supp}_U(M_U)=\{u\in U:(M_U)_u\ne0\}$, using ordinary module stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. For the induced map $|e|:|U|\to|X|$ [def-a1-space-point-topology], one has $\operatorname{Supp}_U(M_U)=|e|^{-1}(\operatorname{Supp}_X(M))$. No finite type, Noetherian, or surjectivity hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Fix $u\in U$, choose a geometric point $\bar u:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U$ centered at $u$, and put $\bar x=e\bar u$. Write $A=\mathcal O_{U,u}$, $B=\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$, and $N=(M_U)_u$. By [lem-sfb-space-quasicoherent-geometric-stalk-tensor], $N\otimes_A B\cong M_{\bar x}$. By [lem-sfb-space-strict-local-flatness], the natural map $A\to B$ identifies with the strict-henselization map of the ordinary local ring, with the residue embedding determined by $\bar u$. Therefore [lem-sc-strict-henselization-faithfully-flat] applies and makes $A\to B$ faithfully flat. These statements require only the given etaleness and quasi-coherence, and do not require $e$ to be surjective.

source.place: Tag 07TY (lemma-support-covering), the stalk tensor formula and faithful-flatness sentences; inputs Tags 05VP, 04KF, 07QM(1).

proof.text: For any faithfully flat $A$-algebra $B$ and any $A$-module $N$, apply [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] to the zero-arrow complex $0\to N\to0$: it is exact precisely when $N=0$, and its tensor by $B$ is exact precisely when $B\otimes_A N=0$. Thus $N=0$ if and only if $B\otimes_A N=0$. Swapping pure tensors gives the inverse isomorphisms $B\otimes_A N\cong N\otimes_A B$ by the universal property [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Together with step 1 this proves $(M_U)_u=0\Longleftrightarrow M_{\bar x}=0$. This argument applies to every choice of $\bar u$, without finite generation or a Nakayama argument.

source.place: Tag 07TY, final zero-detection sentence, expanded directly from the definition of faithful flatness.

proof.text: The vanishing condition defining support is independent of the geometric point, including at points outside the image of the particular $e$. Indeed fix any $x\in|X|$. Choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $a:V\to X$ by [def-trf-algebraic-space], and fix $v\in V$ above $x$. Given any geometric point $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ over $x$, [lem-sfb-etale-geometric-point-specified-lift] lifts this very $\bar y$ to $\bar v:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to V$ centered at the fixed $v$. Apply steps 1 and 2 with $a,V,v,\bar v$ in place of $e,U,u,\bar u$. They give $M_{\bar y}=0$ if and only if $(M_V)_v=0$. The latter module is fixed independently of $\bar y$, proving the claimed independence.

source.place: Tag 07TY, choice of a geometric point over an ordinary point; spaces-properties.tex definition-support (Tag 04KA), independence of the representative; specified lift Tag 05VN.

proof.text: For each $u\in U$, steps 1 and 2 and the independence just proved give $u\in\operatorname{Supp}_U(M_U)$ if and only if $M_{\bar x}\ne0$, if and only if $|e|(u)\in\operatorname{Supp}_X(M)$. Here $|e|(u)$ is represented by $e\bar u$ by [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Equality of the two subsets follows pointwise. If $U$ is empty there are no points to check; if $M=0$ both supports are empty.
